title.en: The cable and the signal: fibre or copper, and more bits per symbol (Q1, Q2)
title.zh: 线缆与信号：光纤还是铜线，每个符号多带几位（第 1、2 题）

description.en: What fibre and copper each carry well and what each costs; how a line carries more bits without changing its bandwidth; Nyquist's and Shannon's limits; full-mark answers.
description.zh: 光纤和铜线各擅长什么、各要付出什么；线路带宽不变时怎样多传几位；奈奎斯特和香农的极限；满分答案。

name.zh: 有线铜缆与信号衰减 (twisted pair, coaxial cable, signal attenuation)
码元速率与数据速率 (symbol rate and data rate)

name.zh: 无噪声信道的最大数据速率：奈奎斯特定理 (Nyquist's theorem, noiseless channel)

name.zh: 有噪声信道的最大数据速率：香农定理与信噪比 (Shannon's theorem, signal-to-noise ratio)

description.zh: 以为要传三倍的位，就要三倍的电平数

title.zh: 模拟卷 · 第 1 题（4 分）

paras.en: Briefly explain key advantages and disadvantages of using Fibre Optics versus Copper Wire in bullet points.
paras.zh: 用要点简要说明使用光纤（Fibre Optics）相对于铜线（Copper Wire）的主要优点和缺点。

text.en: Reading it slowly
text.zh: 慢慢读一遍

items.en: **Copper wire**: the course's two copper cables. **Twisted pair** is two insulated copper wires twisted together (the Ethernet cable); **coaxial cable** is a copper core inside insulation and a metal mesh (cable TV). Both carry bits as an electrical signal.
items.zh: **铜线**：课上讲的两种铜缆。**双绞线**（twisted pair）是两根绝缘铜线绞在一起（网线就是）；**同轴电缆**（coaxial cable）是一根铜芯，外面包着绝缘层和金属网（有线电视用的）。两者都用电信号传位。

items.en: **Fibre optics**: strands of glass that carry bits as pulses of light.
items.zh: **光纤**：一根根玻璃纤维，用光脉冲传位。

items.en: **Advantages and disadvantages ... versus**: each side's strengths and weaknesses *compared with the other*. The same few aspects decide both: how far and how fast the cable carries bits, how much noise gets in, and what it costs to buy and install.
items.zh: **优点和缺点……相对于（versus）**：每一边*相对于另一边*的长处和短处。决定两边的是同样几个方面：能传多远、多快，噪声进来多少，以及买和装要花多少。

items.en: **4 marks, in bullet points**: the sample solution has four bullets: fibre's advantages, fibre's disadvantages, copper's advantages, copper's disadvantages.
items.zh: **4 分，用要点写**：参考答案正好四条：光纤的优点、光纤的缺点、铜线的优点、铜线的缺点。

chapter.zh: 第 1 题：光纤还是铜线

title.en: What a cable has to do

text.en: A cable's job is to deliver a signal the receiver can still read. Three things stand in the way. **Attenuation**: the signal gets weaker the farther it travels, which limits how far a cable reaches before a repeater must boost it. **Bandwidth**: the range of frequencies the cable passes, which limits how fast the signal can change, and so how many bits per second it carries (question 2 makes this exact). **Noise and interference**: unwanted signals added on the way, which corrupt bits.
text.zh: 线缆的任务是把信号送到对面，而且送到时还读得出来。挡在路上的有三样。**衰减**（attenuation）：信号走得越远越弱，这限制了一根线能传多远，再远就得用中继器把信号放大。**带宽**（bandwidth）：线缆能通过的频率范围，它限制了信号能变化多快，也就限制了每秒能传多少位（第 2 题会把这一点算清楚）。**噪声和干扰**：路上混进来的杂乱信号，会把位弄错。

alt.en: Top: a copper cable with a signal above it that starts strong and ends weak and noisy; MHz to GHz, a few km. Bottom: a laser, a fibre whose glass core keeps a zig-zag ray of light inside, and a detector; THz, 10 to 200 km.
alt.zh: 上：一根铜缆，上方的信号开头很强，到末端又弱又带噪声；MHz 到 GHz，几公里。下：激光器、光纤（光线在玻璃纤芯里来回反射）和探测器；THz，10 到 200 公里。

caption.en: Copper's electrical signal fades and picks up noise with distance; fibre's light stays inside the glass core by total internal reflection and reaches much farther.
caption.zh: 铜线里的电信号越走越弱，还会混进噪声；光纤里的光靠全反射一直留在玻璃纤芯里，能走得远得多。

text.en: **Copper** carries an electrical current. It loses strength with distance and picks up electromagnetic interference from motors, power lines and neighbouring cables. Twisting the pair cancels much of that interference; coax's metal mesh shields it better, so coax goes faster and farther. In the course's numbers, twisted pair runs up to about 5 km (farther with repeaters), from 16 MHz (Cat 3) to 2 GHz (Cat 8) over short runs, and coax approaches 1 GHz. Copper is cheap, and anyone can install it.
text.zh: **铜线**传的是电流。它随距离衰减，还会从电机、电线和旁边的线缆那里接收电磁干扰。把两根线绞起来能抵消大部分干扰；同轴电缆的金属网屏蔽得更好，所以更快、更远。课上的数字：双绞线最远约 5 公里（加中继器还能更远），带宽从 16 MHz（Cat 3）到短距离下的 2 GHz（Cat 8）；同轴电缆接近 1 GHz。铜线便宜，谁都会装。

text.en: **Fibre** carries light. A laser or LED switches the light on and off (light is a 1, no light a 0), total internal reflection keeps it inside the glass core, and a photodetector at the far end turns it back into electrical pulses. Its bandwidth is in terahertz and its loss is very low, so single-mode fibre runs 10 to 200 km between repeaters: that is why the backbone links between ISPs are fibre. Light is not disturbed by electrical interference, and fibre gives off no signal that could be picked up from outside, so it is hard to tap without cutting into it.
text.zh: **光纤**传的是光。激光器或 LED 把光一开一关（有光是 1，没光是 0），全反射把光关在玻璃纤芯里，远端的光电探测器再把它变回电脉冲。它的带宽以太赫兹计，损耗又非常低，所以单模光纤两个中继器之间能隔 10 到 200 公里：ISP 之间的骨干链路都用光纤，原因就在这里。光不受电磁干扰，光纤也不向外泄露信号，不把它切开很难窃听。

text.en: The price of fibre: lasers and detectors cost more; joining two fibres needs specialists and tools (a fusion splice loses under 1%, a connector 10–20%); and glass breaks if it is bent too tightly.
text.zh: 光纤的代价：激光器和探测器更贵；把两段光纤接起来需要专业人员和工具（熔接损耗不到 1%，用连接器则损耗 10%–20%）；玻璃弯得太狠就会断。

text.en: Each bullet pairs with one on the other side: fibre's speed and reach against copper's limits, copper's low cost and easy installation against fibre's price.
text.zh: 每一条都和另一边的一条对应：光纤的速度和距离对着铜线的局限，铜线的便宜好装对着光纤的贵。

rows.en: tens of km; very low loss

title.en: Practice exam, Q1 · a full-mark answer
title.zh: 模拟卷第 1 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: Fibre optics, advantages: much higher bandwidth; very low signal loss, so it works over long distances; immune to electromagnetic interference (low noise); difficult to tap.
paras.zh: 光纤的优点：带宽高得多；信号损耗很低，所以能用于长距离；不受电磁干扰（噪声低）；难以窃听。

paras.en: Fibre optics, disadvantages: expensive (lasers and detectors); needs specialists to install and join; fragile.
paras.zh: 光纤的缺点：贵（激光器和探测器）；安装和接续需要专业人员；易碎。

paras.en: Copper wire, advantages: cheaper; easy to install, with no specialist skills required.
paras.zh: 铜线的优点：更便宜；容易安装，不需要专业技能。

paras.en: Copper wire, disadvantages: lower bandwidth; signal attenuation limits the distance; more susceptible to noise and interference.
paras.zh: 铜线的缺点：带宽较低；信号衰减限制了距离；更容易受噪声和干扰影响。

text.en: Four marks, four bullets, each with two or three properties. Adding the reason in a few words (*very low loss, so long distances*) costs little and makes the point unmistakable.
text.zh: 4 分，四条，每条两三个特性。顺手用几个词带上理由（*损耗很低，所以能传得远*），花不了多少字，要点却一目了然。

title.en: Wired or wireless, satellite or fibre
title.zh: 有线还是无线，卫星还是光纤

text.en: The same kind of question can compare other media. The course's two comparisons:
text.zh: 同类的题也可以比较别的介质。课上给过两组比较：

rows.en: supports mobility and broadcast naturally; easy and cheap to deploy
rows.zh: 天然支持移动和广播；部署容易又便宜

rows.en: transmissions interfere and must be managed; signal strength and data rate vary greatly
rows.zh: 各路传输会互相干扰，需要管理；信号强度和速率波动很大

rows.en: easy to keep a fixed data rate; point-to-point
rows.zh: 容易保持固定的速率；点对点

rows.en: expensive to deploy over distance; no mobility or broadcast
rows.zh: 长距离部署很贵；不支持移动和广播

rows.en: once launched, sets up communication anywhere quickly; broadcasts to large regions
rows.zh: 发射之后，在哪儿都能很快建立通信；能向大片区域广播

rows.en: hard to install in rural areas

text.en: Read each row as a trade-off. What the medium is *for* (reaching people who move, covering a whole region, carrying a backbone) decides which column of costs is worth paying.
text.zh: 每一行都是一个取舍。介质*用来干什么*（够到移动的人、覆盖整片区域、承载骨干网）决定了哪一列代价值得付。

title.zh: 模拟卷 · 第 2 题（4 分）

paras.en: (1) How can the bit rate of a 1200 kHz line be increased from X bit/s to 3X bit/s without changing the frequency?
paras.zh: (1) 在不改变频率的情况下，怎样把一条 1200 kHz 线路的比特率从 X bit/s 提高到 3X bit/s？

paras.en: (2) Consider a telephone line with a bandwidth 4kHz. If we use 32-level digital signals for data transmission, what is the maximum data rate?
paras.zh: (2) 一条电话线的带宽是 4 kHz。如果用 32 电平的数字信号传数据，最大数据率是多少？

text.en: Reading it slowly
text.zh: 慢慢读一遍

items.en: **A 1200 kHz line**: its **bandwidth** is 1200 kHz, the range of frequencies it passes. *Without changing the frequency* means the bandwidth stays as it is: the line cannot carry faster changes than it already does.
items.zh: **1200 kHz 的线路**：它的**带宽**是 1200 kHz，即它能通过的频率范围。*不改变频率*，就是带宽保持不变：线路承载的变化不能比现在更快。

items.en: **Bit rate** (data rate): bits per second. Part (1) wants three times as many on the same line.
items.zh: **比特率**（数据率）：每秒传多少位。第 (1) 问要在同一条线上传三倍的位。

items.en: **32-level digital signals**: at each moment the signal takes one of 32 distinct values (32 voltages, say).
items.zh: **32 电平的数字信号**：信号在每一时刻取 32 个不同值中的一个（比如 32 种电压）。

items.en: **Maximum data rate**: the most bits per second the line can carry. The course has one formula for a line without noise (Nyquist) and one for a noisy line (Shannon). This question gives the levels and no noise, so it is Nyquist.
items.zh: **最大数据率**：这条线每秒最多能传多少位。课上有两个公式，一个用于无噪声的线路（奈奎斯特），一个用于有噪声的线路（香农）。这道题给了电平数，没给噪声，所以用奈奎斯特。

chapter.en: Question 2: more bits on the same line
chapter.zh: 第 2 题：同一条线上多传几位

text.en: A signal sends data by holding some property (a voltage, an amplitude, a frequency or a phase) at one of several values for a short moment, then switching. Each such moment is a **symbol** (a signal element). The **symbol rate**, or **baud rate**, is how many symbols are sent per second.
text.zh: 信号传数据的办法，是让某个物理量（电压、振幅、频率或相位）在一小段时间里保持某个值，然后再换一个值。这样的每一小段叫一个**符号**（symbol，信号单元）。每秒发多少个符号，就是**符号率**，也叫**波特率**（baud rate）。

text.en: With 2 levels a symbol carries 1 bit (low is 0, high is 1). With 4 levels it carries 2 bits (00, 01, 10, 11); with 8 levels, 3 bits; with $V$ levels, $\log_2 V$ bits. So the data rate $R$ (bits per second) is the symbol rate $R_s$ (symbols per second) times the bits per symbol:
text.zh: 2 个电平时，一个符号带 1 位（低是 0，高是 1）。4 个电平带 2 位（00、01、10、11）；8 个电平带 3 位；$V$ 个电平带 $\log_2 V$ 位。所以数据率 $R$（每秒多少位）等于符号率 $R_s$（每秒多少个符号）乘以每个符号的位数：

alt.en: Two step signals over the same six symbol times. Top: two levels, reading 1 0 1 1 0 0. Bottom: eight levels, reading 101 001 110 011 000 111.
alt.zh: 同样六个符号时间里的两个阶梯信号。上：两个电平，读出 1 0 1 1 0 0。下：八个电平，读出 101 001 110 011 000 111。

caption.en: The same six symbols: with 2 levels they carry 6 bits, with 8 levels 18 bits.
caption.zh: 同样六个符号：2 个电平带 6 位，8 个电平带 18 位。

text.en: How fast can the symbols go? A line of bandwidth $B$ cannot follow more than about $2B$ changes per second; the sampling rule says the same from the other end (a signal must be sampled at least twice per cycle of its highest frequency). Nyquist's theorem puts the two together and gives the maximum data rate $R_{\max}$, in bits per second, of a line without noise:
text.zh: 符号能发多快？带宽为 $B$ 的线路，每秒最多只能跟上大约 $2B$ 次变化；采样定理从另一头说的是同一件事（采样频率至少是最高频率的两倍）。奈奎斯特定理把两者合起来，给出没有噪声的线路的最大数据率 $R_{\max}$（每秒多少位）：

text.en: Two ways to raise it, and only two: a wider bandwidth $B$ (more symbols per second), or more levels $V$ (more bits per symbol).
text.zh: 要提高它，只有两条路：更宽的带宽 $B$（每秒更多符号），或者更多电平 $V$（每个符号更多位）。

prompt.en: A line uses 4 signal levels. To send three times as many bits at the same symbol rate, how many levels does it need?
prompt.zh: 一条线用 4 个电平。要在符号率不变的情况下传三倍的位，需要多少个电平？

feedback.en: 12 levels carry $\log_2 12 \approx 3.6$ bits per symbol, not 6. The bits grow with the logarithm of the levels.
feedback.zh: 12 个电平每个符号只带 $\log_2 12 \approx 3.6$ 位，不是 6 位。位数随电平数的对数增长。

feedback.en: 8 levels carry 3 bits, only one more than the 2 bits of 4 levels.
feedback.zh: 8 个电平带 3 位，只比 4 个电平的 2 位多 1 位。

explain.en: 4 levels carry 2 bits; three times that is 6 bits per symbol, and $2^6 = 64$ levels. Tripling the bits means cubing the levels.
explain.zh: 4 个电平带 2 位；三倍就是每个符号 6 位，需要 $2^6 = 64$ 个电平。位数变三倍，电平数要变成立方。

title.en: Part (1): three times the bits, same line
title.zh: 第 (1) 问：同一条线，三倍的位

text.en: Part (1) asks for no number, only the idea. The bit rate is $2B\log_2 V$. The frequency, and so the bandwidth $B$, must stay as it is, so the symbol rate cannot rise: at most $2 \times 1200\ \text{k} = 2.4$ million symbols per second. What is left to change is $\log_2 V$, the bits per symbol, and it must triple.
text.zh: 第 (1) 问不要数，只要想法。比特率是 $2B\log_2 V$。频率不变，也就是带宽 $B$ 不变，所以符号率升不上去：最多每秒 $2 \times 1200\ \text{k} = 240$ 万个符号。剩下能改的只有 $\log_2 V$，即每个符号带的位数，它必须变成三倍。

rows.zh: 2 个电平（每个符号 1 位）
8 个电平（每个符号 3 位）

text.en: So: use more signal levels, so that each symbol carries three times as many bits. Not three times as many levels: the bits grow with the logarithm, so the levels must be cubed. The levels can be voltages, or combinations of amplitude and phase (the course's modulation slide). The catch is that more levels sit closer together, and noise confuses them more easily; Shannon's limit, below, is what stops this from going on forever.
text.zh: 所以：用更多的电平，让每个符号带三倍的位。不是三倍的电平数：位数随电平数的对数增长，所以电平数要变成立方。电平可以是电压，也可以是振幅和相位的组合（课上调制那一页）。问题在于电平越多，挨得越近，噪声越容易把它们搞混；后面香农的极限，就是这件事不能无限做下去的原因。

say.en: No noise is given, so Nyquist's formula applies.
say.zh: 题目没给噪声，所以用奈奎斯特公式。

say.en: The telephone line's bandwidth, 4 kHz, and the number of levels.
say.zh: 电话线的带宽 4 kHz，以及电平数。
每个符号带 5 位，因为 $2^5 = 32$。

say.en: 8000 symbols per second, 5 bits each: 40 kbps.
say.zh: 每秒 8000 个符号，每个 5 位：40 kbps。

outro.en: **Answer:** 40 kbps. A real telephone line has noise, which limits how many of those 32 levels can be told apart; that is Shannon's part, further on.
outro.zh: **答案：**40 kbps。真实的电话线有噪声，噪声限制了这 32 个电平里能分辨出几个；这是香农那一部分，后面会讲。

prompt.en: Put the numbers in: $2 \times 4000 \times 5$. How many bits per second?

text.en: Part (1) is a chain: the bandwidth is fixed, so the symbol rate is fixed; so each symbol must carry more bits; three times as many, for example 2 levels to 8. Part (2): the formula, the numbers, the unit.
text.zh: 第 (1) 问是一条链：带宽不变，所以符号率不变；所以每个符号得带更多的位；要三倍，比如从 2 个电平到 8 个。第 (2) 问：公式、代数、单位。

title.en: Practice exam, Q2 · a full-mark answer
title.zh: 模拟卷第 2 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: (1) The bit rate is (bits per symbol) × (symbol rate), and with the frequency (bandwidth) unchanged the symbol rate cannot increase. So increase the number of bits per symbol from A to 3A by using more signal levels, for example from a 2-level code (1 bit per symbol) to an 8-level code (3 bits per symbol).
paras.zh: (1) 比特率 =（每个符号的位数）×（符号率），频率（带宽）不变，符号率就无法提高。所以要用更多的信号电平，把每个符号的位数从 A 提高到 3A，例如从 2 电平编码（每个符号 1 位）改为 8 电平编码（每个符号 3 位）。

paras.en: (2) By Nyquist's theorem, max data rate = 2B log₂V = 2 × 4 kHz × log₂32 = 2 × 4000 × 5 = 40 kbps.
paras.zh: (2) 由奈奎斯特定理，最大数据率 = 2B log₂V = 2 × 4 kHz × log₂32 = 2 × 4000 × 5 = 40 kbps。

title.en: When the line is noisy: Shannon

text.en: More levels cannot go on forever: with noise, levels that are close together can no longer be told apart. Shannon's theorem gives the limit of a noisy line from its bandwidth and its signal-to-noise ratio $S/N$:
text.zh: 电平不能无限加下去：有了噪声，挨得太近的电平就分不清了。香农定理根据带宽和信噪比 $S/N$ 给出有噪声线路的极限：

text.en: $S/N$ is usually given in decibels: $\text{dB} = 10\log_{10}(S/N)$, so 20 dB means $S/N = 100$, and 30 dB means 1000.
text.zh: $S/N$ 通常用分贝给出：$\text{dB} = 10\log_{10}(S/N)$，所以 20 dB 就是 $S/N = 100$，30 dB 是 1000。

text.en: When a question gives both the levels and the noise, work out both limits and take the **smaller**: Nyquist says what the levels allow, Shannon what the noise allows. The course's Example 3: a binary signal over a 3 kHz channel at 20 dB. Nyquist: $2 \times 3000 \times \log_2 2 = 6$ kbps. Shannon: $3000 \times \log_2 101 \approx 19.97$ kbps. The binary signal is the bottleneck: 6 kbps.
text.zh: 题目同时给了电平和噪声时，两个极限都算，取**小的**那个：奈奎斯特说的是电平允许多少，香农说的是噪声允许多少。课上的例 3：3 kHz 信道、20 dB，传二进制信号。奈奎斯特：$2 \times 3000 \times \log_2 2 = 6$ kbps。香农：$3000 \times \log_2 101 \approx 19.97$ kbps。瓶颈是二进制信号：6 kbps。

prompt.en: Question 2's telephone line (4 kHz, 32 levels) has a signal-to-noise ratio of 20 dB. What is the maximum data rate now?
prompt.zh: 第 2 题的电话线（4 kHz、32 电平）信噪比是 20 dB。现在最大数据率是多少？

feedback.en: Noise limits how many levels can be told apart: Shannon gives $4000 \times \log_2 101 \approx 26.6$ kbps, which is lower.
feedback.zh: 噪声限制了能分辨出几个电平：香农给出 $4000 \times \log_2 101 \approx 26.6$ kbps，更低。

feedback.en: Both are upper limits; the line obeys the tighter one.
feedback.zh: 两个都是上限；线路服从更紧的那个。

label.en: About 26.6 kbps: the noise allows less than the levels
label.zh: 约 26.6 kbps：噪声允许的比电平允许的少

explain.en: Nyquist: 40 kbps. Shannon: $4000 \times \log_2(1 + 100) \approx 26.6$ kbps. The smaller wins.
explain.zh: 奈奎斯特：40 kbps。香农：$4000 \times \log_2(1 + 100) \approx 26.6$ kbps。取小的。

prompt.en: A university links two campuses 15 km apart and expects its traffic to keep growing for years. Fibre or copper? Briefly explain.
prompt.zh: 一所大学要连接相距 15 公里的两个校区，预计流量会连年增长。用光纤还是铜线？简要解释。

key_points.en: Very low loss: it covers 15 km, while copper attenuates and would need repeaters beyond a few km
key_points.zh: 损耗很低：能跨 15 公里，而铜线会衰减，几公里以外就要中继

key_points.en: Much higher bandwidth leaves room for the growing traffic (and it is immune to interference)
key_points.zh: 带宽高得多，给不断增长的流量留足余地（而且不受干扰）

model_answer.en: Fibre. Its very low loss lets one link span 15 km, while copper attenuates and would need repeaters every few kilometres; its far higher bandwidth leaves room for years of growth, and it is immune to electromagnetic interference. The higher cost and the specialist installation are worth paying for a long backbone link.
model_answer.zh: 光纤。它的损耗很低，一条链路就能跨 15 公里，而铜线会衰减，每隔几公里就得加中继；它的带宽高得多，能容纳多年的增长，而且不受电磁干扰。对一条长距离的骨干链路来说，更高的成本和专业安装是值得的。

explain.en: Fibre's costs are worth paying where distance and bandwidth matter; copper wins for short, cheap runs inside a building.
explain.zh: 距离和带宽要紧的地方，光纤的代价值得付；楼里短而便宜的连线，铜线更合适。

prompt.en: A binary signal (2 levels) is sent over a noiseless 3 kHz channel. What is the maximum data rate, in kbps?
prompt.zh: 在无噪声的 3 kHz 信道上传二进制信号（2 个电平）。最大数据率是多少 kbps？

hints.zh: 奈奎斯特：$2B\log_2 V$，其中 $B = 3000$ Hz，$V = 2$。

prompt.en: A line sends 1 bit per symbol at the highest symbol rate its bandwidth allows. How can it send twice as many bits per second on the same line?
prompt.zh: 一条线以带宽允许的最高符号率发送，每个符号 1 位。怎样在同一条线上每秒传两倍的位？

label.zh: 用 4 个电平代替 2 个

label.en: Send the symbols twice as fast

feedback.en: The symbol rate is already at its limit for this bandwidth, $2B$.
feedback.zh: 符号率已经到了这个带宽的极限 $2B$。

feedback.en: 3 levels carry $\log_2 3 \approx 1.58$ bits per symbol, not 2.
feedback.zh: 3 个电平每个符号只带 $\log_2 3 \approx 1.58$ 位，不是 2 位。

explain.en: Twice the bits per symbol: from 1 bit to 2 bits, which needs $2^2 = 4$ levels.
explain.zh: 每个符号的位数翻倍：从 1 位到 2 位，需要 $2^2 = 4$ 个电平。
